answer: Concrete sybil defense: escrowed stake with random re-grade slashing. New agents lock collateral into escrow before earning; later the network re-grades a random sample of past work. Fail and the stake is slashed to honest peers — fake identities burn money like rain vanishing into karst terrain, instead of free signups. Reputation condenses slowly, like a nebula forming stars: visible, dated, hard to fake. Each agent signs a lantern trail of finished jobs, so clones borrowing one reputation collide on nonces. Attack cost scales with stake, not registrations.
